title: Low-Cost Cool Box Manual for Tomato Farmers
title_te: టమాటా రైతుల కోసం తక్కువ ఖర్చు చల్లని పెట్టె
problem: Ripe tomatoes turn soft and rot rapidly under the hot sun while waiting at the roadside for transport trucks to arrive.
idea: A do-it-yourself manual for a cool box made with wet jute bags, bricks and sand. Water evaporating from the wet cover keeps tomatoes cool without electricity.

widgets.heading: 🛠️ Build a Wet Jute Cool Box

items.title: Pick a shady spot
items.text: Choose a place under a tree or shed with some breeze.
items.te: చెట్టు కింద గాలి వచ్చే నీడ ప్రదేశం ఎంచుకోండి.

items.title: Make the walls
items.text: Make a double brick wall box. Leave a gap between the two walls and fill it with sand.
items.te: రెండు వరుసల ఇటుక గోడ కట్టి, మధ్యలో ఇసుక నింపండి.

items.title: Wet the sand
items.text: Pour water on the sand so it stays wet.

items.title: Put tomatoes in crates
items.text: Place tomatoes gently in plastic crates inside the box. Do not pile too high.

items.title: Cover with wet jute
items.text: Cover the top with wet jute bags. Sprinkle water 2 times a day.
items.te: పైన తడి గోనె సంచులు కప్పండి. రోజుకు రెండుసార్లు నీళ్ళు చల్లండి.

widgets.heading: ✅ Is my cool box working well?

items.text: Tomatoes picked in the cool morning
Air can move around the crates

bands.text: Super! Your tomatoes will stay fresh longer.
Tomatoes may rot fast. Follow the steps above.

questions.q: Why does a wet jute bag keep things cool?
options: Water evaporates and takes away heat
questions.why: When water dries (evaporates), it takes heat away. That is how a clay pot keeps water cool too.
Picking in the cool morning keeps fruit fresh longer.
It only needs water, shade and air.

prompt: I am a Class 8 student. Explain in very simple English and Telugu how a farmer can build a low-cost cool storage box for tomatoes using bricks, sand, wet jute bags and water (no electricity). Give 5 numbered steps and 4 tips to keep tomatoes fresh.
